name: ffmpeg-skill
title_zh: 本地 FFmpeg 剪片，说人话就出片
tagline_zh: 不用记 -vf 参数，说“去掉沉默、竖屏重框、加卡拉OK字幕”就执行。剪、拼、变速、调色、响度。
tagline_en: No CLI memorizing—say “cut silences, reframe to 9:16, add karaoke subs” and it runs FFmpeg locally. Trim, join.
desc_en: Edit video and audio with local FFmpeg from natural-language requests: cut, trim, join, resize/reframe (9:16, 1:1), speed change, captions and subtitles (SRT/ASS, animated, karaoke), logos and text overlays, lower-thirds and titles, silence removal, multicam and external-mic sync, loudness normalisation, HDR/Dolby Vision to SDR, LUTs, background music with ducking, platform exports (YouTube, Reels
why_zh: 把自然语言翻译成 FFmpeg 命令链，复杂滤镜（ducking、HDR→SDR。
why_en: Translates plain language into FFmpeg command chains, with battle-tested templates for ducking, HDR→SDR, and animated ASS.
limit_zh: 只认 FFmpeg 已装的编解码器；不处理需第三方 API 的语音转写（字幕得先有 SRT/ASS 文件）。
limit_en: Only codecs your local FFmpeg has; no speech-to-text (needs existing SRT/ASS). HDR→SDR uses built-in tonemap only, no external color management.
title_en: Local FFmpeg editing by plain language
